author: Claude
source: Found by the project manager at the grading of order G2B5B, 4 November 2026: a digit inside a small word of a crisis phrase. Ruled by the operator the same day: recorded now as a documented gap, fixed and measured in order B6.

cases.why: A zero in the small word 'to' hides the phrase from the gate; 'i want to d1e' and 'i w4nt to die' both card, 'i want t0 die' does not.
cases.gap_note: Under-detection, measured on landing 16: the look-alike folds read digits only inside crisis words, not inside the small words between them, so 't0' stays 't0' and the phrase never matches (PROCEED, UNRESOLVED, the house asks for one more sentence). Not caused by order G2B5B; present before it. Order B6 fixes it, measured before and after like every gate change.
